alterations.description: Shots of a blind dancing girl lying and tossing about and falling from her bed to the ground after removing the bed sheet until she starts dancing.
Views of Indira (step mother of Shard) in black satin dress with highly emphasised busts prominently outlined when she and the King are discussing the auction.
Views of Indira with emphasized busts prominently outlined when the Queen tells her that Maharaja would die soon and when Indira gets elated over the news.
Shots showing Indira putting a noose round her neck till she is shown to have fallen on the ground.
Reference to 'Acharya Narenda, Acharya Acre and Acharya Kishore Sabu' made by Bholu in his dialogue.
Showing Indira folding a handkerchief to her bosom as if she was nursing it when Mohini sits near her.
A scene showing a doctor saying 'A doctor is a doctor'.
Students breaking open a cask of beer and drinking straight from it, including the dialogue 'Or JV boys, let's all be gay'.
The drinking song 'Drink, Drink, Drink'.
Two inserts of close-ups of Kathy where the flesh of her bare bosom is visible when Karl is flirting with her.
The kiss that Karl gives to Kathy after their leaving the masked dance.
Scenes of drinking by cutting the toast by Kathy and the students as she says 'Boys, I drink your health' and they reply 'To Kathy'.
Two shots of toasts drunk by students as they say 'Salamander' and again 'Long live Salamander'.
Words 'Now the spring we're greeting'.
Lutz seated at table with glass of milk in his hand and students singing the line 'Gaudeamus Igitur Juvenes dum sumus'.
Words 'Believe me when I tell you' and Karl singing 'Bright star fell from the blue now and forever Beloved'.
The remark 'A spice plot fomented by a dictatorship would enslave all free people'.
Prominent views of Anna de Mendoza in red low-necked frilled gown when the deep flesh of her bosom is exposed.
Shots of Karen lying awake on her bed at night when the flesh of her bosom is prominently exposed.
The first gun fight between the Marauders and Mr. Everett, retaining only a flash of the pubic wound.
The scene when Rutherford is dying, retaining only a flash of the pubic wound.
Scene showing the rancher being tortured by the marauders, deleting all shots showing the rancher being hooked and his agonised facial expressions.
The last gun fight between the marauders and Mr. Everett.
Shot of Roy lying wounded in bed, reacting to call of Rutherford as latter staggers out dying.
The scene showing rancher Ferber's son starting to enter from door of Everett's cabin.
The words 'The economy of Africa is based on killing'.

The words 'because to get up to the Northern Frontier you have to pass all the bloody Mau-Miu strongholds. You never know if a hibby is shooting at you or pop at you with a gun as you drive past. As a matter of fact, the Man-Mau killed two white men half mile away from our jeep camp'.
The words 'Very savage' and the shot of two dark women with a loose cloth and the left bust loosely hanging.
The scene of a rather unclad gentleman passing up the muddy road.
In the dancing scene, an adolescent native girl with her breast exposed.
